profileLabel: Slight center-left economics (medium confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Camarines Sur 2nd District representative with 160 principal-authored bills. Authored a private basic education voucher program, a P15,000 across-the-board wage increase, a plastic-bag excise tax, a higher SEF rate, a green jobs act, a national electronic health record system, a false-information penalty and bank anti-corruption transparency. Co-authored national minimum wage and economic relief for workers.
caveat: Voucher program pulls right while wage and green-jobs bills pull left. False-information and bank-transparency bills are single issues and not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a P15,000 across-the-board wage increase (-2), a green jobs act (-1) and plastic-bag excise and higher SEF rate (-1), offset by a private basic education voucher program (+2). Four issues, bill-based.
